parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Oh, oh! The closing speech is about to start! [p], hurry up!

parts.text: Lullaby grabs you by the hand, gentle but still guiding. Some sprinkles from your triple double mega ultra super sundae fall off.
Crowds begin to gather by the giant center, larger than imaginary life.
Your eyes are glued to the center spotlights, seems like it’ll be a few minutes before-
-wait… who’s…
Crowd Goer: “I heard Evelyn herself is speaking! Can you believe it?!”
That person looks-
“Ohmygosh, and Limerence is making a guest appearance too!”
-weren’t they- ugh, it’s too hard to
“When’s it starting?! I can’t wait any longer!”
-focus. Everyone’s so loud…
Lullaby, doesn’t that person-

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Oh, huh? Sorry, did you say something?

parts.text: Doesn’t that person look familiar?
You point at a strange imaginary friend in the far left corner of the crowd.
Crap.
Both your hearts sink as you realize what’s happening. The two of you immediately start pushing through the crowd to the other side, trying to confirm for sure.
After many “sorry”s and “excuse us!”s you finally get a close look at the figure, and she gets a close look at you.
The two of you make chase, tailing right behind as the sounds of the crowd grow quieter and quieter.
The roars of excitement dim to sounds of footsteps on gravel and grass, heavy breaths, and Lullaby’s shouts.
Finally, *finally*, you get the figure pinned to a dead end.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: AAARGH, stop running already you’re insufferable!

parts.text: The sheer vitriol in the tone of Lullaby’s voice catches you off guard, it’s completely out of pocket from how she usually sounds.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Why were you stealing earlier?! Give back what you took.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Nothing? Do we have to beat it out of you?

parts.text: L-Lullaby…
The figure readies herself, drawing forward one hand which is now glowing bright with imanagination and energy.
Lullaby pushes you away with her water magic, forcing you to watch from a distance once more.
